text: Funding-rate arbitrage (long spot, short perp), the capital that takes the other side of leveraged long demand, is not risk-free. He et al.: it 'is not risk-free even disregarding margin requirements and trading costs, simply because there is no predetermined expiration date when the trade would be unwound at a profit', and temporary worsening of apparent arbitrage opportunities 'can lead to liquidations and losses'. BIS: engaging in cash-and-carry is risky because of spikes in margins and liquidations amid drawdowns. (high confidence)
keywords: Funding as carry and short squeeze dynamics

text: Auto-deleveraging (ADL) can close winning shorts. Hyperliquid: if an account's value or isolated position value goes negative, opposite-side users are ranked by unrealized PnL and leverage using (mark_price / entry_price) x (notional_position / account_value), and are closed at the previous mark price. FTI: on 2025-10-10 'some of the best-hedged shorts found their positions reduced or entirely closed', which can turn a hedged portfolio into a naked one. BitMEX: ADL across multiple exchanges disrupted delta-neutral strategies, forced professional market makers to cut liquidity, and left order books at their thinnest since 2022. (high confidence)
keywords: Funding as carry and short squeeze dynamics
